published_implementation.historical_relation: The initial per-user soul mutation and storage path was introduced by commit 379193861165e1ca3784c1c65927297fb42429c6. The effective-soul isolation/readback regression was added by commit fb9247456d8f8b0a469aaeecfdb46e3f2b4866b8. Both commits are ancestors of the canonical assessed Octos revision.

observations.evidence_surface: Octos canonical gateway soul effective-state regression test
observations.result_summary: At the canonical assessed Octos revision, first-party tests exercise durable soul-state storage and the user-facing gateway effective-state transition from profile-wide soul to a per-chat override and back to profile-wide state after reset. The same revision contains the system-prompt construction path that reads profile soul state for runtime prompt composition.
observations.notes: This record is function-neutral. The regression observes mutation and effective-state readback but does not execute a later model turn, measure task behavior under the changed state, or establish production deployment history.
